title: Measuring Delay on Detoured Wayfare Rides Trips
content:
The measured delay minutes on a detoured trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** are worked out from how the route ran: the trip's actual miles against its estimated miles, and whether the trip carries a toll charge.

## Rule

1. **Toll detour.** On a trip whose actual miles reached at least 1.40 times its estimated miles (the toll-detour ratio) and that carries a toll charge — showing the driver left the direct route for a toll road — the measured delay is the time spent on the extra miles: the actual miles less the estimated miles, multiplied by the actual minutes, divided by the actual miles.
2. **Minor detour.** On any other trip whose actual miles reached at least 1.10 times its estimated miles (the minor-detour ratio), the measured delay is the actual minutes less the estimated minutes scaled to the miles driven — the scaled figure being the estimated minutes multiplied by the actual miles and divided by the estimated miles — and never below zero.
3. On any other trip the measured delay is left as it stands.

## Truth table

| Actual miles at least 1.40 times estimated | Toll charge on the trip | Actual miles at least 1.10 times estimated | Measured delay |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | time on the extra miles (rule 1) |
| yes | no | yes | actual minutes less scaled estimate, not below zero (rule 2) |
| no | either | yes | actual minutes less scaled estimate, not below zero (rule 2) |
| no | either | no | left as it stands (rule 3) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical trip: estimated 10 miles and 20 minutes)

- Actual 15 miles, 33 minutes, toll charge on the trip: ratio 1.5, rule 1 — 5 extra miles multiplied by 33 minutes, divided by 15 miles: **11 minutes**.
- Same trip with no toll charge: rule 2 — scaled estimate 20 multiplied by 15, divided by 10, is 30; 33 less 30: **3 minutes**.
- Actual 12 miles, 22 minutes: ratio 1.2, rule 2 — scaled estimate 24; 22 less 24 is below zero: **0 minutes**.
- Actual 10.5 miles, 33 minutes: ratio 1.05, below 1.10 — rule 3, left as it stands.
